# Doit Then 1.0.30
- Added checklist templates, custom templates, and Sample Workweek. - Improved planner sections and cross-Mac synchronization. - Improved undo and redo for Reminders lists. - Added guarded two-way Calendar Mirror synchronization. - Added best-effort automatic removal of managed iCloud copies when their Google originals disappear. - Added deletion verification periods of 2 minutes, 2 hours, and 10 hours depending on the extent of missing source events. - Improved synchronization recovery, ownership verification, and interrupted-write protection.
Automatic removal remains best-effort. Prolonged calendar-provider outages may still cause unintended deletion of managed copies.
